title: Annotatio VI §.IV: Picherellus — metonymic speech occasioned belief Indigni eat the body
pass_a_gloss: Hence Picherellus the Pontifician: Moreover, he says, the Fathers’ metonymic locutions afforded many occasion why they should believe even the unworthy eat Christ’s body.
pass_b_english: The Fathers’ metonymic turns gave many occasion to believe the unworthy eat Christ’s body.
source_text: Hinc Picherellus Pontificius: Ceterum, inquit, Patrum metonymica locutiones occasionem multis præbuêre, cur & indignos crederent corpus Christi manducare.
